svg.title: What no-slop changes
svg.desc: Without no-slop, a user must remember several separate skills, general cleanup can flatten their voice, copied skills can become outdated, and the final review can be skipped. With no-slop, one skill chooses the writing or interface checks, applies the user's voice afterward, proposes community-skill updates for review, and can use an optional Stop hook to catch a missed final review. The public download includes starter rules and community skills, while personal samples, exceptions, and learned corrections start empty.

g.text: What /no-slop changes
It coordinates the checks, protects your voice, and makes the final review harder to forget.
WITHOUT /NO-SLOP
Several good skills.
No shared process.
You must remember which skill to use.
General cleanup can flatten your real voice.
Downloaded skill copies can stop receiving improvements.
The final review is easy to skip.
ONE ENTRY POINT
WITH /NO-SLOP
The right checks, followed
by your voice.
Chooses the writing or interface checks.
Humanizer + Stop Slop for writing. Taste + Impeccable for interfaces.
Applies your rules and samples after the general cleanup.
Proposes community-skill updates for you to review.
Can catch a missed final review with the optional Stop hook.
The hook checks the review. It does not rewrite the work.
Starter rules and community skills are included. Your personal samples, exceptions, and learned corrections start empty.
